notes.title: Episode Two
notes.notes:
Good afternoon, we present to you a small continuation of the storyline. An update with a new episode is now available!

We also decided to simplify the gameplay of the 1st chapter and added a checkpoint system.

Download and stay tuned for new updates!

notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, dear players!
The release of the Inquisitor’s Heart and Soul game took place. 
Summon demonic invasions, punish heretical enclaves, punish traitors and renegades. Do not deny yourself anything - after all, you are the hand and anger of the highest good. Give the apostates darkness, so that they learn to appreciate the light!
Hurry up to purchase with 15% discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310954/90aa26218ba8a775b675d5d7b6d6878f5f6223b1.png[/img]
